name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with a bar or rope.
Hinge slightly forward with arms extended.
Pull the bar down to your thighs keeping your arms straight.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A cable pulldown with straight arms that isolates the lats.
